THE DIRECTIONS

You will talk to four people. Record what you would say to each one. You can record again as many times as you want. When all four are recorded, click Submit.

The first time you press record, your computer will ask to use your microphone. Click Allow.

THE SCENE

Your class is outside at a big world map painted on the yard. Your team will draw the path of one idea across the map. You keep your team's notebook. It needs four places and the year the idea got to each one. Four people can each give you one.

THE HISTORY

This map follows one idea, called a constitution. A constitution is a written law that leaders must follow. In 1861, Tunisia wrote the first one in the Arab world. It said the ruler must follow the law too.
